data.name: Hukaymah
data.gender_notes: Hukaymah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'khakm', meaning 'wisdom' or 'judgment'. A name for a girl who is believed to possess great wisdom and the ability to provide sound advice and guidance. The name Hukaymah carries the meaning “Wise Counselor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hukaymah usually hope their child will grow to embody wise counselor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of the wisdom and guidance provided by Allah (swt) and the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
data.etymology: Hukaymah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise Counselor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hukaymah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
